reviews.text: It’s really light coverage, so if you want covergae, this one is not for you.I would like a bit more coverage But it’s perfect for a no make up look. I think it’s a bit to light for me in summer but i think it will be perfect in winter. The formulation is really thin so i feel nothing on my skin. But i think your should really prep your skin and finish with powder since it can look a bit cakey of i have some imperfections.(bc of the coverage) But it’s actually really really good.(and cute tho) mine has a pink undertone
reviews.zh: 遮瑕真係好低，所以想要遮瑕嘅人就唔啱你。遮瑕度我想要再多少少，不過就啱晒偽素顏妝。夏天用對我嚟講可能太透，冬天用應該就剛剛好。質地真係好薄，搽上面好似冇搽過一樣。不過皮膚真係要打底做好同最後定妝，因為有暗沉位嘅話會有少少浮粉感（因為遮瑕太低嘅關係）。但其實真係幾好。（包裝幾靚）我嗰款帶粉調底色。

reviews.text: I love the packaging for this cushion as it has a mesh top instead of a sponge like many others. I find that it's less messy and gives you a just the right amount of product so you don't get too much. The foundation is light coverage with a dewy finish. It feels like you aren't wearing anything, but it's only slightly buildable so if you need medium to full coverage this isn't the foundation for you. With that said it comes in only 3 shades with this being the middle shade and it's very light. Doesn't oxidize much if at all so you are getting a close to true color right after application.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款氣墊嘅包裝，用網面而唔係海綿，比好多其他款乾淨。每次取出嚟嘅粉底量都啱啱好，唔會搞到太多。粉底係輕遮瑕加水光妝效，感覺好似冇化妝一樣，不過只可以稍為疊加少少，所以需要中至高遮瑕嘅人就唔啱。唯一要提嘅係得三隻色號，我揀嘅係中間色，仲要好淺。幾乎唔氧化變色，所以一上妝就係好接近真實嘅顏色。

reviews.text: Bought this because of wonyoung photocard. The photocards are cute, however I’m a bit disappointed in the cushion. It has a really pretty glow on your skin but it doesn’t conceal anything! It’s more like a primer than a foundation to me. It’s too natural that looks like I didn’t put on any makeup. Also the colour is a big darker than I thought. This “1.5 natural” looks like 23 in other brands. So if you have good skin and want a natural dewy look, that’s for you. But if you want to conceal some flaws and have a better skin look, don’t get this one.
reviews.zh: 因為想要wonyoung小卡所以買咗。小卡係幾靚嘅，不過對呢個氣墊有少少失望。上面之後皮膚光澤幾靚，但係完全唔遮瑕！對我嚟講更似打底多過粉底。妝感太自然，自然到好似冇化妝咁。而且顏色比我想像中深好多。呢個「1.5 natural」睇落似其他牌子嘅23號。所以如果你皮膚好又想自然水光妝，呢個啱你。但如果想遮吓瑕疵、等皮膚睇落好啲，唔好揀呢個。

reviews.text:
Pros: 
This cushion foundation is super lightweight and almost feels like there is nothing on your skin. I have dry skin and it does not claim to my dry patches. It is great for a simple no make up look or if you are somewhere where you don’t really want to wear heavy makeup, like the beach.

Cons: 
If you are looking for medium to full coverage or you are very oily, this is not the cushion for you. This has light coverage with a slightly dewy finish. Therefore, it won’t cover red acne spots, dark circles, or sun spots completely even with multiple layers. That said, you could try and pair this with a concealer for better coverage if you really wanted to.
reviews.zh:
優點：
呢個氣墊粉底超級輕透，貼到好似皮膚上冇嘢咁。我係乾性肌，用完都唔會卡住我嘅乾皮。想化簡單偽素顏妝，或者去啲唔想化太濃妝嘅地方（例如沙灘），都好適合。

缺點：
如果你想要中至高度遮瑕，或者你係大油肌，呢個氣墊就唔啱你。佢係輕遮瑕加少少水光妝效，所以就算疊幾層都唔可以完全遮到紅色暗瘡印、黑眼圈或者色斑。不過如果你真係想遮得好啲，可以配遮瑕膏一齊用。

reviews.text: Estoy enamorada de este compacto. El color salió un poco más claro que el color de mi piel porque soy latina. Lo que hago es que me aplico poco para que difumine con mi color de piel y se vea bien. Me humecta la piel, se ve saludable, no me brota. Mi piel es súper sensible y encontrar por primera vez una base que me cubra y no me brote la piel es un rotundo éxito.
reviews.zh: 我完全愛上咗呢個氣墊。色號出咗比我膚色淺少少（因為我係拉丁裔）。我嘅做法係薄薄上，等佢同自己膚色融合就睇落自然。佢會幫皮膚保濕，望落好健康，冇令我爆瘡。我皮膚超級敏感，能夠第一次搵到一支遮得到但又唔爆瘡嘅粉底，簡直係大成功。

reviews.text: Feels like a skin tint! My skin is neutral leaning warm tone and the shade match was perfect (I am very pale). That being said, if you are even a little bit tan this shade range will not work for you. I like to apply this in 2-3 light layers to have a natural coverage. If you want full coverage this cushion is not for you. The makeup sponge is okay, nothing special. I find that I have to go back in with a brush to blend everything out and to cover my large pores. Overall, this cushion feels very comfortable and light on the skin. I think it would work for all seasons!
reviews.zh: 似係膚色調色液！我膚色係中性偏暖，色號夾得好完美（我好白）。不過如果你有少少曬黑，呢個色號範圍就唔啱你喇。我會分2-3層薄薄上，造出自然遮瑕。如果想全遮瑕，呢個氣墊就唔啱你。個粉撲一般，冇咩特別。我發覺最後要用返支掃先可以推開晒同遮到我啲大毛孔。整體嚟講，呢個氣墊貼住皮膚好舒服好透。我覺得四季都用得！

reviews.text: I really like this cushion! the shade is very light but it works for me! It lasts probably 3ish hours with setting powder, but it's not really school air proof if you know what I mean. I would recommend using setting powder with it because its glowy but can look a little bit greasy in different lighting, such as school lighting. If you have a dryer, flakier skin it tends to make that a little bit more noticeable.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個氣墊！色號係幾淺但係啱我用！配合碎粉定妝大概可以keep到3個鐘左右，但係就唔算真正防汗（你明我意思嗰種）。建議要配合碎粉一齊用，因為佢係水光感，但喺唔同光線下（例如學校嘅燈）會望落有少少油光。如果你皮膚比較乾、甩皮，呢個會令情況明顯啲。

reviews.text: This stuff is amazing. It doesn’t budge or crease all day. Which shocked me because I thought it being dewy would make it move like crazy. I was wrong. It’s very light coverage, so it’s good for more natural days(barely enough to cover acne). It’s great for evening out skin tone. I have combo/oily skin and it wears great on me, so much people complimented me on how nice my skin looked. My issue is the shade range I’m usually the lightest/rosy shade but this is way to pale even for me. I hope it’s just because it’s early fall/summer and I can wear this shade during winter. I would just keep that in mind for anyone like myself. The cushion itself is amazing though. I recommend just make sure to cross reference for correct shade. Also the packaging is so so cute! I love this set 💗
reviews.zh: 呢樣嘢勁正。成日都唔甩妝、唔卡紋。令我好驚訝，因為我以為水光感嘅妝會好易溶。係我錯。佢遮瑕好輕，所以適合想自然啲嘅日子（差啲唔夠遮暗瘡）。均勻膚色效果好正。我係混合偏油肌，用住都好正，好多人都讚我皮膚望落好靚。我嘅問題係色號範圍——我通常用最淺／偏粉紅嘅色號，但呢個連我都覺得太白。希望只係而家初秋／夏天嘅關係，到冬天可以襯返呢個色號。同我情況相似嘅朋友記住留意呢點。不過個氣墊本身真係好正。推薦畀大家，不過記住要對清楚色號。仲有包裝好可愛！我好鍾意呢套💗
